items.question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
items.ours_sql: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC NULLS LAST) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON CAST(T1.CDSCode AS BIGINT) = CAST(T2.cds AS BIGINT) WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND NOT CharterNum IS NULL
items.official_sql: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC NULLS LAST) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND NOT CharterNum IS NULL
items.sqlite_sql: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null

items.question: What is the average score in writing for the schools that were opened after 1991 or closed before 2000? List the school names along with the score. Also, list the communication number of the schools if there is any.
items.ours_sql: SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.Phone FROM schools AS T2 LEFT JOIN satscores AS T1 ON CAST(T2.CDSCode AS BIGINT) = CAST(T1.cds AS BIGINT) WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.OpenDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') > '1991' OR TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.ClosedDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') < '2000'
items.official_sql: SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.Phone FROM schools AS T2 LEFT JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.OpenDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') > '1991' OR TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.ClosedDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') < '2000'
items.sqlite_sql: SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.Phone FROM schools AS T2 LEFT JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) > '1991' OR strftime('%Y', T2.ClosedDate) < '2000'

items.question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
items.ours_sql: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON CAST(T1.cds AS BIGINT) = CAST(T2.CDSCode AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(T1.NumTstTakr, 0) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1
items.official_sql: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(T1.NumTstTakr, 0) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1
items.sqlite_sql: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: What is the postal street address for the school with the 7th highest Math average? Indicate the school's name.
items.ours_sql: SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON CAST(T1.cds AS BIGINT) = CAST(T2.CDSCode AS BIGINT) ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
items.official_sql: SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
items.sqlite_sql: SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 6, 1

items.question: What is the percentage of Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text box? List them by their ID.
items.ours_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(id), 0) FROM cards WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1
items.official_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 AND isStorySpotlight = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(id), 0) FROM cards
items.sqlite_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) FROM cards WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1

items.question: For the user No.24, how many times is the number of his/her posts compared to his/her votes?
items.ours_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.Id) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id), 0) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24
items.official_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Id) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id), 0) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24
items.sqlite_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24

items.question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?
items.ours_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTRING(T2.Date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012'
items.official_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' THEN CAST(T2.Consumption AS float) ELSE 0 END) -SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN CAST(T2.Consumption AS float) ELSE 0 END) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE substring(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
items.sqlite_sql: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'CZK', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'EUR', T2.Consumption, 0)) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

items.question: What's the nationality of the customer who spent 548.4 in 2012/8/24?
items.ours_sql: SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price = 548.4
